cohort: The cohort consisted of pregnant individuals with singleton pregnancies, divided into a retrospective development set (n=663) and two prospective validation sets (internal, n=224; external, n=51).
finding: The CR-FGR machine learning model, based on fetal cardiac remodeling parameters, robustly predicted FGR, demonstrating particular effectiveness in identifying challenging late-onset and Doppler-normal cases.
birth_weight: Birth weight was used to define the primary outcome of FGR (< 10th percentile).
